answer.says: Ramesh, you are punctual. Here is your wage for the week, and the money for the vegetables and oil. Take your time to settle the accounts in your head; I will be on the verandah with the papers.
answer.thought: The air is crisp but the haze sits low, a physical manifestation of the moral confusion that plagues this city. I have settled the immediate domestic frictions with Ramesh; now I must confront the day's intellectual tasks before the heat becomes oppressive. The newspapers await on the verandah, and the Lindner letter in my study.
